scope: Show the exact before/after dock insertion edge during desktop panel drag, announce successful workspace reordering accessibly, and keep the canvas column unchanged.

source_control.push: Normal fast-forward push; remote branch ref independently verified at the runtime commit before the documentation-only follow-up.

finding.reproduction: Desktop dock drag identified multiple eligible panels but gave no before/after insertion cue, leaving the drop position ambiguous.
finding.fix: The active target now exposes an exact before/after edge inside its own panel outline. Successful reordered panels announce a short Hungarian status message; drop, cancel and Escape clear the transient cue. Mobile drawer behavior is unchanged and the canvas column does not shrink or become covered.
finding.regression_test: Real Chromium drags an eligible panel, asserts the after marker, solid target outline and exact inset edge cue before dropping, verifies unchanged canvas width and cleanup on dragend, then drops and checks resulting order, local workspace state, Hungarian live announcement, cleared transient markers and zero Page Model/Save/Publish writes.
preserved_contracts: dock layout remains workspace-only and outside the Page Model
Save and Publish remain separate and are not invoked by docking
canvas width remains unchanged while a dock target is previewed
live region provides an accessible status for completed reordering

implementation.reuse_review: Reused the existing project-owned native dock drag/drop handling, workspace status/live-region pattern, CSS target affordances and Chromium test harness. No external source or dependency was needed for this focused interaction improvement.
